content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes strong language and sexual dialogue, though no direct sexual acts are depicted.
It contains scenes involving graphic violence, criminal behavior, depictions of suicide, and explicit portrayals of bodily harm.
Some dialogue features sexually explicit or abusive language.
Additionally, the story includes a scene involving an attempted sexual assault, which may be distressing to some players.
These themes may be disturbing or triggering for some audiences.
Player discretion is advised.
